# RealHunt

> Independent AI analysis of real estate listings worldwide. Paste any property listing URL and get a 0-100 Global Score built from five forensic dimensions: ROI Potential, Market Stability, Demand Strength, Safety Score and Liquidity Outlook.

RealHunt is not a broker and takes no commission on sales. Rankings carry no paid placement. Every published report is available at a public /r/:slug URL.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Analyze any property listing URL and see the latest scored homes.
- [Method](/method): Full public methodology — every dimension, weight, source and known limitation.
- [Rankings](/rankings): Live global leaderboard of the highest-scoring analyzed properties.
- [Discover](/discover): Feed of recently analyzed properties across all markets.
- [Market directory](/market): Index of city and country market pages.
- [Compare](/compare): Side-by-side comparison of up to four analyzed properties.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Free, Pro and Agent plans.
- [For agents](/for-agents): Branded client-ready reports and the Verified by RealHunt badge.
- [Contact](/contact): How to reach the team.

## Examples

- [Example report](/r/la-clinique-swiss): A full forensic report for a single listing.
- [Best deals by country](/best-deals/spain): Country hub of top-scoring listings.
- [City market page](/market/madrid): City-level scoring and price context.
